description: Colorizes a black-and-white or faded photo. Costs 10 credits; returns a project id for wait_for_image_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use the named attachment fields first for ChatGPT files. Ask which file goes where if their roles are unclear. If a file fails, ask the user to attach it again and keep the requested settings.

Idempotency-Key.description: A unique string for this request, such as a UUID. Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the original project instead of creating and charging for a new one. A key applies across all video, image, and audio endpoints on your account, so use a new key for every project.

assets.description: Provide the assets for photo colorization

image_file_path.description:
The image used to generate the colorized image. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

image.description: Attach the image from ChatGPT for this input.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS download URL supplied for the native ChatGPT attachment, including its signed query.
download_url.title: Download Url

file_id.description: Native ChatGPT file identifier paired with download_url; not a local filesystem path.
file_id.title: File Id

file_name.description: Original attachment filename, when supplied by ChatGPT.
file_name.title: File Name

mime_type.description: Attachment MIME type, when supplied by ChatGPT.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

image.title: ChatGPTFile

name.description: Optional project name for identifying this output. Omit to use the API's default project name.

name: colorize_photo

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the image. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the image(s), credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the image. Use it with the [Get image Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/image-projects/get-image-details) to fetch status and downloads.
